title:
Epic that clears the field values of the specified {@link UiSdlForm}s and
the provided {@link SettableApplicationState}.

Payload should receive the following values:
  formIds (required) - The ids of the {@link UiSdlForm}s to clear the form fields values of.
  applicationStateId (optional) - The id of the application state to clear.
name: ReliabilityClearFormsAndApplicationStateEpic
